title: One Commercial Credit Account per Customer
content:
**Credit policy manual — account structure.**

A customer may hold only one Commercial Credit Account at a time; all ship-to locations, programs and agreements of the customer bill to that single account. The number of credit accounts a customer may hold at one time is 1.

### Clauses

1. A new credit application is not taken when the customer already has a credit account whose status is applied, active, on hold or in collections.
2. A customer whose earlier account was declined or closed may submit a new application, and the new application is decided on its own merits under the credit application decision rules.

### Basis of the check

The check rests on the system record: the customer's credit accounts and the status each one carries, matched on the customer. What the customer says about an earlier account does not replace that record.

| Status of the customer's existing credit account | New application taken? |
|---|---|
| applied | no |
| active | no |
| on hold | no |
| in collections | no |
| declined | yes, decided on its own merits |
| closed | yes, decided on its own merits |

*Example (hypothetical):* a customer whose only earlier account shows status closed may apply again; the same customer with an account shown as on hold may not, whatever the balance on it.
